_note: uv sync --extra aigamestore: the vendored aigamestore-gym env (vendor/aigamestore), which needs a Chromium browser (system Chrome by default). Lock-stepped: fps must equal 60 / frame_skip (10 with the default frame_skip 6).
_keys_note: MultiKeySpec over the game's keys: curriculum 'keys' map a physical key (the JSON key -- a scanner button, say) to the key the GAME listens for (the value, e.g. 'SPACE'); held keys combine, and the logged action is the env's 0/1 vector over its keys. Collect cheese to open the mouse hole, then escape before the cats catch you. The on-canvas hints are relabelled to the pressed key by the env; keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
